notes.title: Devblog #22 - A Few Words Before Release
notes.notes:
Welcome Future Presidents!
The time has come to have a little chit-chat about the last few years of development. Some of you are new here, others have been with us for years, and all of you are waiting for the next week’s release! We dug up some ancient screenshots and decided to unearth some old features that haunt us to this day. Some of them got substantial upgrades while others were banished to the shadow dimension. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32571749/6b246e0af1f9161760737776b7ef49e669632972.png[/img]

The entire UI got a facelift, we decided to ditch the see-through brown color scheme and make the game actually pleasant to look at. Reading is a huge part of the playthrough, so better contrast and nicer colors will strain your eyes much less.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32571749/013ecd17df58d176131236ff45964c9ffedc1206.jpg[/img]

The map has gone through more iterations than we can count. To reach this state of readability we had to change almost everything a couple of times. Countries show their names in a more readable manner and filters will help you optimize your strats. Even interactions have become more cohesive and readable.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32571749/b7c79f478cc102c5af9968bce8c4b71792f49d7c.jpg[/img]

Stats may seem the same, but a lot has changed under the hood. They have become much more predictable and easier to understand. We added helpful hints to allow so more controlled drops and rises.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32571749/5be667455170a1ea418e8fc71089f5dcdd0c0820.png[/img]

The game's internal websites were given a more modern look. They no longer look like something straight out of the 90s. News sites will be one of the most crucial sources of knowledge when it comes to your citizens' opinions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32571749/4268ef2a3a21f5296e66fe615a2fc131040172bf.png[/img]

The Oval Office doesn’t look like a mix of random assets anymore. We fixed the horrible lighting and installed new furniture. On top of that, we added a brand new set, which will be a part of the overall experience, so have fun in the Air Force One. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32571749/81164dbcff4052136681892167bae74d8360d583.png[/img]

We dropped the card game, who wants to play a dumbed-down version of war with coin flip? In its place, we added new features we hope you will like. Negotiations have become much more immersive, as they are a part of the story and crisis that you will have to survive through.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32571749/428cfa3d52c1a887793a7a1dc93d31eef5c5c154.gif[/img]

When works on I Am Your President started we were much younger and it taught us a lot. In the end, this game tested our abilities and challenged our ambitions. This has been a crazy journey for the entire team as well as all people who have supported us over those years. So we hope that you enjoy our experiment as much as you enjoyed the Prologue we released before.
Thank you for your patience and support, we could have not done this without you.
The entire Dev Team

notes.title: I Am Your President: Prologue - Patch #2
notes.notes:
[h1]Hi everyone! [/h1]

We continue to implement your ideas into the game. For now, we want to release a small patch that should[b] improve loading times on HDD[/b] drives. We're adding a few other things as well, hopefully it will improve your prologue experience;).

[list]
[*] Game Settings: [b]Run In Background switch added[/b]. While loading, the app has Run In Background active on default, so it's still loading when minimized. You can change this option whenever you want.
[*] [b]Better loading times[/b] - we've found out what caused the game to load so slowly and we've fixed it. Our work is not yet done here, but the improvements are big. In the nearest future the loading times will get even quicker.
[*]Items description now shown in each turn - this is our experimental feature, to deepen the immersion. Tell us what you think about it. 
[*]Fixed some bugs
[*]Probably added more bugs than before
[/list]

We are in touch. Remember that you can write to us on Discord. We also read all your opinions sent via the form available in the game :). Your opinion is very important to us. It helps us improve our game. 

Cheers!

notes.title: I Am Your President: Prologue - Release
notes.notes:
[h1]The time has come everyone![/h1]

We are proud to announce that [b]I Am Your President: Prologue is finally out![/b] Moreover, [b]it is – now and forever – free to play![/b]

You can find it here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1201330/

Experience the events leading up to the presidency of Your President – from the perspective of his predecessor! Try to finish this self-contained story to get a taste of what it means to occupy the oval office and know whose shoes you will be filling in the main game. Just keep in mind the fact that being the leader of the free world is no easy task and the outcome of this grand balancing act will be – in the best case scenario – bittersweet.

The prologue is also a great way to familiarize yourself with the core game mechanics and features, most of which are included, albeit in a much more straightforward form. Sign legislation, post on social media, tackle international crises as they unfold, survive the barrage of questions at a press conference and much, much more… Overall, completing the prologue should take you approximately 40 minutes, though that can vary depending on the path you choose. And if you are a completionist – there’s a bunch of Steam achievements for you to unlock!

A huge “thank you” goes out to everyone that has been supporting IAYP project and – as always – if you have any questions or feedback to us, feel free to drop us a message on our Discord – we read all of them and continuously improve based on your input!

Talk to you soon!
~IAYP team

notes.title: IAYP PROLOGUE RELEASE
notes.notes:
Tis the time for some more news regarding IAYP!

The biggest of which is: We are about to publish the prologue to I Am Your President – scheduled for release on [b]Dec 2nd @ 9:00 AM PST! [/b]And once published, it’s going to be here to stay: for [b]free[/b] & forever!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1201330/I_Am_Your_President_Prologue/

Those of you that had a chance to play our demo will recognize the story of the prologue – albeit slightly tweaked and expanded so that we could showcase a few previously unseen features (such as the map and another location outside of the White House)! Oh, and this time around, your successes (and failures) will be immortalized via Steam achievements. Overall we are hoping to give you a smoother and more complete experience that will eventually serve as a proper teaser for the main game.

Speaking of which, from the moment we release the prologue, our entire team’s main focus is going to shift entirely to polishing and testing the main plotline – a huge milestone we’re really excited about! Hopefully, the next time we break the silence we will have something cool to tell you!

And of course, once again, thank you guys for your ongoing love and support! We're doing our best to answer all of your questions at #ask-us-anything  (Discord) – and the closer the game is to the finished product, the easier they are to answer.

So feel free to share your thoughts & head down to Steam to check out I Am Your President: Prologue once it comes out! :)

notes.title: Demo Update - Patch notes #1
notes.notes:
[b]Demo update![/b]

First of all, thank you all so much for your feedback and all the kind words! We’ve been working hard on improving the demo as much as possible & we’re happy to say that we’re launching an update that should both make the game easier to run and improve the overall playing experience.

Here’s the full changelog:
•    The lighting effects have been optimized, which should help with the FPS on older PCs
•    Lowered the overall difficulty of the game & introduced some balance changes
•    Save system bugfix – it should be functional now
•    Tooltips have been made more visible
•    In order to help with the confusion, we’ve added a few tutorial boxes that explain how the game’s basics work
•    Rich text tags for documents that require signing have been fixed
•    Fixed the cabinet member summary screen
•    Fixed the industry icon in the cabinet member menu
•    Added an option to skip the intro if the player finished it in the previous playthroughs
•    Added an animated indicator for development strategies that are being researched
•    Fixed the problem with the player being transported back to the oval office after the endgame cutscene
•    Fixed the bug that made it possible to accept the statements without filling in all the boxes
•    Improved the display of the closing credits
•    Fixed Life of the Party and Savoir-Fair quests; they should work fine now
•    Various text corrections
•    Various fixes to hidden plot hooks
•    Various email, article and Screecher QoL improvements and fixes (e.g. bigger database of Screecher commentators)
•    Visual improvements to the development strategies and projects to make them more user-friendly
•    Longer answer times for the press conference
•    The default resolutions of the textures has been lowered to improve performance on older machines
•    Better scaling of statistic change tooltips
•    Sound effects added to the email interface
•    The game supports some other screen proportions now

notes.title: Demo release and big status update – October
notes.notes:
Dear fans, we hope you’re doing well in these strange times!

We’ve spent the last few weeks furiously debating and considering all foreseeable angles and can
finally provide you with a bit of an insight into our little IAYP project. I’ll divide this text into two
parts: raw facts (for the TL;DR people out there) and a meandering, in-depth explanation for those of
you that appreciate brutal honesty and full transparency.

[h1]SO, WHAT’S THE PLAN?[/h1]
I’ll start by addressing the elephant in the room: the final version of I Am Your President will not be
released in October – for reasons I’ll get into in the second part. [b]Instead, on the 7th, we will release a short demo available throughout the autumn edition of The Steam Game Festival.[/b] We’d love to hear
your thoughts on the features presented in the demo version – not only in terms of bugs or potential
quality-of-life improvements, but also in more general terms. Think of it as a vibe check. ;)

The demo will include the prologue’s storyline; this way we can avoid spoiling the main game, while
presenting a consistent narrative. Relive the election year as the former president: see if you manage
to fulfill political expectations and experience the events that unfold directly before the start of the
main game! And don’t get discouraged if you fail at first – there’s always a strategy or a project you
can invest in to bolster your vulnerabilities.

We’re also considering putting together an early access version of IAYP and providing those of you
that’d be interested in participating with beta keys. We still have tons of ideas we’d love to include in the final version and your dynamic feedback would help us tweak them in real time! And on that note,
we could even prepare a roadmap to give you some idea of what features we’ll be implementing
next, so let us know what you think!

Finally, as per the original plan, the prologue in its final form will be published 2-3 weeks before the
main release. Since it’s a self-contained storyline, it serves as a perfect testing ground for seeing how
adding various features impacts the gameplay.

[h1]BUT MR. GAME DESIGNER, WHY WOULD YOU DELAY THE RELEASE? WHAT DID WE DO FOR YOU TO HURT US LIKE THAT?[/h1]
To quote a famous British chef: it’s <bleep> raw!

Admittedly, it’s a bit embarrassing. We’ve got some good ideas, great ingredients and – most
importantly – amazingly supportive audience waiting for the final product! So, what went wrong?

[olist]
[*]We do not want to betray your expectations – nor the work we’ve already put into the game.
We can release the full game only once; and as much as everyone in our small team would
like to end the crunch, these final touches often make or break the gaming experience.
[*]We’d still like to work on a portion of the features, and especially the interactions between
various gameplay elements – as I’ve mentioned before: the core story and gameplay is ready,
though we’re not entirely happy with how these cogs align. IAYP needs to pull off this crazy
balancing act of being both narrative-driven and highly randomized, meaning that all the
puzzles must fit together extremely well.
[*]We’re still figuring out how pronounced certain things should be – as with any creative
project, IAYP has evolved considerably throughout its development; we’ve added hidden
stats, emotions, animations, dozens of project and tech trees and so much more. This
requires us to update or interlink the older, plainer content and figure out if we’ve missed or
overemphasized anything. Do people want more graphs? Fewer nukes? Skeletons? Memes?
Only some solid testing will tell.
[*]And lastly – on a more egotistical note – I feel personally responsible for some of the delay.
You see, I’ve been tasked with fleshing out the main plotline and went a bit crazy with it
(duh). I’ve thrown enough temper tantrums to convince my colleagues to prepare a number
of features distinct from the rest of the game. And also include some unnecessarily complex
formulas to make certain plotlines feel more organic. And also have branching out game
endings. And… well, you get my point – and know who to blame in case you find the main
plot dumb.
[/olist]

So, to sum up, we are sorry for delaying the release. At this moment, we’re a bit reluctant to suggest
a new release date – life has taught us that these things are really hard to gauge, but we’ll try to be
ultra honest and transparent with the game’s status. And, most importantly, to do our absolute best
to provide you with a great gaming experience! Anything less would be a disservice to your sustained
interest in and support of IAYP. Once again: thank you for your patience and all the kind words!

~Miłosz (Meatplanter)

notes.title: Release date!
notes.notes:
[h1]Release the President![/h1]

Yes, this is it, the date you’ve been all waiting for... but before that, we want to thank you for patience, and the trust you put in us – we are doing our best to release the refined game with a lot of extra features and interesting storyline. Unfortunately it takes some time, but your devs are working hard :)

Without further ado, let’s announce the official release date of I Am Your President!
All signs point to one month of the current year and this is…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32571749/8ebc8063ad9da0eb7a22edf9342cf0b335be544f.jpg[/img]

October 2020!
It will also be the time of the upcoming presidential election in the U.S, so we would be glad to boost the anticipation with our game. In the end, what could be sweeter than actually choosing the best available president – yourself?

Nevertheless, please keep in mind that the exact day of the premiere depends on some factors we cannot always control. Still, we are taking aim at October release and most certainly we want to publish the game before the factual election in the USA.

So, behold! Start counting days and be present on Discord ([url=https://discord.gg/g9KjvP3]link[/url]), where all the news will be aired and questions answered. In the meantime – await the next DevBlog, and do not forget to add our game to you Steam wishlist!

notes.title: Changelog - November 2019
notes.notes:
With the end of current month we finished some things. Here is the list:

[h1]1.0.b5 - November[/h1]
[olist]
[*] Dialogues - Added ability to express emotions for president's guests, improved guests animations
[*] Reworked UI Statistics - added fancy animations
[*] Added Atomic Thread to the World Map - Your actions against the world won’t go unnoticed. The greatest of this world are watching. Atomic Thread indicator will tell you how close you are to starting a world war - meaning Game Over. However, this will not cancel your plans to conquer (almost) the whole world. Atomic Thread indicator will decrease its value over time and through your other ingame actions such as dialogues, negotiations or social media. Gaining more and more value at diplomacy statistic will also help you to calm down other world leaders.
[*] Press Conference feature is implemented - you can answer journalist's questions. Answering or ignoring journalists will affect your statistics values and story alike. If you promise something publicly people will remember. Unless you manage to get out of it. Just like politicians in real life. 
[*] Press Conference Room Modeling - we are still waiting for a new room model and new models for journalists.
[*] Selecting the members of the Cabinet of the United States is implemented - Player is able to assign politicians to various Cabinet positions. For Example: Secretary of Defense. 
Having a dream team is a huge part of your career success. They will help you cope with difficult situations such as your decision burdening the economy of the state or unpopular decision among citizens. Unfortunately, not all of them will be useful or may be useful only on specific Cabinet positions. 
[*] Negotiations aka Card Game - Yes, we heard some of you. Yes, Card Games are bad, but there is nothing to worry about. If you are not interested in playing through this, you have a second option - Negotiations through further dialogue.
[/olist]

[/list]


We know that you would love to have the game released. Unfortunately, we do not want to release a game that is not finished. It wouldn't be fair to you. That is why we are asking for a little more patience. 

Greetings :)
